verdict.rationale: Alma's pricing page lists dependent filings as a flat-fee service line ('I-539 dependent (per dependent) $700'), so dependent petitions are a documented part of its service. However, the evidence never names O-3 or H-4 classifications and never mentions dependent work authorization (e.g., H-4 EAD). Missing for 10: explicit O-3/H-4 coverage, dependent work-authorization (EAD) filings, documentation of the dependent process beyond a price line, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service

citations.quote: The priced service menu includes dependent filings: "I-539 dependent (per dependent)" as its own flat-fee line item.
